notes: §1985:XIII.4.5.2 admits a report file only as `OPEN {OUTPUT {file-name-1 [WITH NO REWIND]}... | EXTEND {file-name-2}...}...`. BindOpen resolves the report file (admitsReportFile), CheckOpenModeForFile refuses INPUT and I-O for a report file (COBOL2371), CheckOpenTapePhrase refuses NO REWIND after EXTEND (COBOL1803), and the 2023-only sharing-phrase and retry-phrase are gated at 85 (VisitOpenStatement for SHARING, the retry-phrase-2002 construct for RETRY, both COBOL0900). Probes at --std 85 with FILE STATUS: OPEN OUTPUT ... WITH NO REWIND gives 07 on the disk file, report written; OPEN EXTEND afterwards gives 00 and appends (file holds HELLO twice); (b) OPEN INPUT and OPEN I-O of the report file COBOL2371; OPEN EXTEND ... WITH NO REWIND COBOL1803; `OPEN OUTPUT.` (no file) COBOL0001; one file twice in one OPEN gives 41 on the second; (c) OPEN OUTPUT SHARING WITH NO OTHER and OPEN OUTPUT RETRY 3 TIMES both COBOL0900; (e) OPEN EXTEND of a missing OPTIONAL report file gives 05 then CLOSE 00; a failed OPEN OUTPUT (bad path) gives 30. The witness (OPEN OUTPUT / EXTEND of a report file) passes.

next.reason: 1985: "OPEN { OUTPUT {file-name-1 [WITH NO REWIND]} … | EXTEND {file-name-2} … } …"; 2023: "{ open-mode } [ sharing-phrase ] [ retry-phrase ] { file-name-1 [ WITH NO REWIND ] } …". Report files stay limited to OUTPUT [NO REWIND] or EXTEND (SR-1, SR-6), but the 2023 format adds sharing-phrase and retry-phrase, with no rule barring them for report files.
